message.text:
The frontend auth interceptor is located at `web/src/connect.ts` and is named `authInterceptor`.

The interceptor manages an access token (Bearer) and a refresh token (HTTP cookie). The access token is stored in localStorage via `auth-state.ts`. The refresh token is sent as a cookie with `credentials: "include"` and is handled by a `refreshToken` RPC. Backend validation occurs in the `server/auth` package.

The frontend auth interceptor is located at web/src/connect.ts.

It manages access tokens via Bearer Authorization headers and refresh tokens via localStorage. Backend validation is handled by the server/auth package's Authenticator.
